defs.def: to try very hard to do sth when it is difficult or when there are a lot of problems 奋斗；努力；争取

ex.s: The government has struggled to come up with measures to address the problem, particularly in the poorer, rural areas east of the Volga River, including arranging doctor’s appointments by video chat and expanding financial aid programs to motivate doctors to practice medicine in remote parts of the country like Krasnoyarsk.
ex.t: 政府努力想出措施解决这个问题，尤其是在伏尔加河以东较贫困的农村地区，包括通过视频聊天安排医生预约，并扩大财政援助项目以激励医生到克拉斯诺亚尔斯克等偏远地区行医。

ex.s: Tom watched his mum make healthy fruit infusions but then struggle for a take-along option.
ex.t: 汤姆看着妈妈制作健康的水果饮品，但随后在为随身带的选择上犯难。

ex.s: Many of their families were struggling to make ends meet.
ex.t: 人们互相帮助，共同应对挑战。

ex.s: Many of their families were struggling to make ends meet.
ex.t: 人们互相帮助，共同应对挑战。

ex.s: The brave men, living and dead, who struggled here, have consecrated it far above our poor power to add or detract.
ex.t: 在这里奋斗过的勇士们，无论生死，已使这片土地神圣化了，远非我们微薄之力所能增损。

defs.def: to move somewhere or do sth with difficulty 艰难地行进；吃力地进行

ex.s: After struggling for quite a while, I made a difficult decision—leaving my job and studying my design course full time.
ex.t: 挣扎了相当一段时间后，我做了一个艰难的决定——辞职并全日制攻读设计课程。

defs.def: to fight against sb/sth in order to prevent a bad situation or result 斗争；抗争

ex.s: Europe Struggles with Heat Wave Countries in Southern Europe have issued warnings after temperatures rose to 40°C.
ex.t: 欧洲遭遇热浪 在南欧国家气温升至 40°C 后，各国已发布高温警告。

defs.def: to fight sb or try to get away from them 搏斗；扭打；挣扎脱身

ex.s: After that incident, I stopped acting as a “Chinese teacher.” Instead of correcting others when they were struggling to pronounce my name, I just smiled and nodded approvingly.
ex.t: 那次事件后，我不再担任“汉语老师”。“当别人挣扎着说出我的名字时，我没有纠正别人，我只是微笑着点头表示赞许。

ex.s: Perhaps she had been struggling against the window too long and was too tired?
ex.t: 也许她在窗户边挣扎太久，累坏了？

ex.s: For almost a year I struggled on, constantly staring at this wall that faced me.
ex.t: 近一年来我一直在挣扎，不停地盯着那堵正对着我的墙。

ex.s: Pruitt tries to give his donations to families that are 29    struggling.
ex.t: 普鲁特尽量把他的捐赠送给那些经济上   29    困难的家庭。

ex.s: Salinger started writing short stories in high school, but later struggled to get his works published.
ex.t: 萨林杰在高中时开始写短篇故事，但后来却为自己的作品出版而挣扎。

defs.def: to compete or argue with sb, especially in order to get sth 争夺；辩论
a hard fight in which people try to obtain or achieve sth, especially sth that sb else does not want them to have 斗争；奋斗；努力

ex.s: But as we’ve reshaped the world around us, dramatically reducing the cost and effort involved in obtaining calories, we still have the same brains we had thousands of years ago, and this mismatch is at the heart of why so many of us struggle to resist tempting foods that we know we shouldn’t eat.
ex.t: 但当我们重新塑造周围的世界，大幅降低获取卡路里所需的成本和努力时，我们仍然有我们几千年前拥有的同样的大脑，这种不匹配现象正是我们许多人努力抵制诱人的食物的核心，而我们知道我们不应该吃这些食物。

ex.s: “For example, most of us would expect older drivers always go slower than everyone else but surprisingly, we found that in 30mph zones they struggled to keep at a constant speed and so were more likely to break the speed limit and be at risk of getting fined.
ex.t: “例如，我们大多数人都以为老年驾驶者总是比其他人开得慢，但令人惊讶的是，我们发现，在限速30英里每小时的区域，他们难以保持匀速，因此更有可能超速并被罚款的风险。

ex.s: They will be testing various medicines in a struggle to find a cure .
ex.t: 他们将测试各种药物，努力寻找治疗方法。

ex.s: Pierre de Coubertin Founder of the modern Olympic Games The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not to win but to take part, just as the most important thing in life is not the triumph but the struggle.
ex.t: 皮埃尔\u00b7德\u00b7顾拜旦 现代奥林匹克运动会创始人 奥林匹克运动会最重要的不是获胜而是参与，正如人生最重要的不是凯旋而是奋斗。

ex.s: End one's struggle for liberty．
ex.t: A．结束对自由的抗争。

ex.s: As I served the role of vital communication link, I was reminded of my desperate struggle to converse before I learned English.
ex.t: 当我担任重要的沟通桥梁角色时，我想起了自己在学会英语之前拼命试图交流的痛苦挣扎。

defs.def: a physical fight between two people or groups of people, especially when one of them is trying to escape, or to get sth from the other 搏斗；扭打；（尤指）抢夺，挣扎脱身

ex.s: We’ve all been there: in a lift, in line at the bank or on an airplane, surrounded by people who are, like us, deeply focused on their smartphones or, worse, struggling with the uncomfortable silence.
ex.t: 我们都经历过这样的情况：在电梯里、在银行排队或在飞机上，周围的人像我们一样全神贯注地看着智能手机，或者更糟的是，在不舒服的沉默中挣扎。

ex.s: After a struggle, she managed to free the vehicle and continued inching along the snow-covered road.
ex.t: 一番挣扎后，她设法把车弄了出来，继续在积雪覆盖的道路上缓慢前行。

ex.s: She ceased her struggle the instant I picked her up.
ex.t: 我一把她抱起来，她就停止了挣扎。

defs.def: something that is difficult for you to do or achieve 难事

ex.s: Would you BET on the future of this man？ He is 53 years old． Most of his adult life has been a losing struggle against debt and misfortune． A war injury has made his left hand stop functioning， and he has often been in prison． Driven by heaven﹣knows﹣what motives， he determines to write a book．
ex.t: 他已经53岁了，他的成年生活大多是债务和不幸的失败。战争的伤害使他的左手停止了运转，他经常在监狱里。由于天知道什么动机，他决定写一本书。
